'''Elso Magua''' was a settlement that was located on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Genarius]], in the [[Cularin system/Legends|Cularin system]]. In c. [[31 BBY/Legends|31 BBY]], the [[Believers]] [[Sith cult/Legends|Sith cult]] had elements of their organization operating in Elso Magua, and the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]] was aware of the cult's presence there.
